title: A Long Carry
summary: Mags Rampart wants 4 planks carried from the far end of Highcliff to Tuck Copley at the stable yard before the road officer rides through.
offer_text: "The planks are by my door and Tuck Copley is waiting at the stable yard. It is a long walk and I have a bad knee. Take them over before the road officer rides through."

objectives.text: Take 4 planks from outside Mags's door
Hand the planks to Tuck Copley
